primitives.name: Roster Evidence Lattice
primitives.verbatim_quote: # BUILD-NRT-039: GSE Rating roster context remediation ## Duplicate Gate duplicate_check_status: EXTENSION matched_existing_ids: BUILD-GV2-011 relation_to_existing: Extends existing source freshness/player surface/data quality work with roster-specific truth rules.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F': 'fact, dimensionless', 'S': 'source, dimensionless', 'T': 'timestamp, seconds since epoch', 'E': 'evidence ID, string'}
primitives.assumptions: Each roster fact F is associated with a source S and timestamp T; evidence E is uniquely identified.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When F conflicts across S, temporal precedence applies.

layer2.mapping: Lattice of facts F mapped to source credibility weights w(S) and temporal validity v(T), enabling GSI Bayesian inference.
layer2.telemetry: Conflict count per fact, source freshness score

primitives.name: Canonical Fact Reconciliation
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Reconciliation Plan Compare official, open-data, and fallback records fact-by-fact.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'F_{\\text{off}}': 'official fact, dimensionless', 'F_{\\text{open}}': 'open-data fact, dimensionless', 'F_{\\text{fallback}}': 'fallback fact, dimensionless', 'w_{\\text{off}}': 'weight of official, unitless', 'w_{\\text{open}}': 'weight of open-data, unitless'}
primitives.assumptions: Official sources have higher weight than fallbacks; reconciliation resolves conflict via weighted majority.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When w_{\text{off}} < w_{\text{open}}, fallback may override.

layer2.mapping: Reconciles F_{\text{off}}, F_{\text{open}}, F_{\text{fallback}} into canonical F^{\text{canon}} = \arg\max_{F} w(F)
layer2.telemetry: Reconciliation success rate, conflict resolution time

primitives.name: Stale Fact Detection
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Validation Plan Run roster:audit, roster:verify, roster:conflicts, roster:stale, and test:roster once implemented.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t_{\\text{now}}': 'current time, seconds since epoch', 't_{\\text{last}}': 'last update time, seconds since epoch', 'T_{\\text{threshold}}': 'stale threshold, seconds'}
primitives.assumptions: A fact is stale if t_{\text{now}} - t_{\text{last}} > T_{\text{threshold}}.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Stale facts are flagged for manual review or automatic deactivation.

layer2.mapping: Detects stale facts via time-delta comparison; triggers alert or deprecation logic.
layer2.telemetry: Number of stale facts, average staleness duration

This lattice is enriched with temporal and source credibility metadata. The reconciliation kernel operates by comparing official, open-data, and fallback records, selecting the highest-weighted valid fact. A stale fact detector monitors temporal consistency, flagging outdated assertions. These primitives form a dual structure: one for truth maintenance (lattice + reconciliation) and one for integrity assurance (stale detection). Failure modes include stale data rendering, conflicting evidence not resolved, and incorrect source weighting. The system must maintain a consistent, verifiable state through these operators.
